name: zclass_world_new
description: zClass_World::gwWorldNew allocates a world node, initializes default world data, inserts it into bucket 13, and returns the node.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this constructor helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4501c0 validates AllocNodeFromFreeList, class id 2, calloc of 0xac world data bytes, zeroed fog/list/partition fields, scale axes initialized to 1.0f, flags initialized to 1, partition max DEC feature count initialized to 16, bucket 13 insertion, and node return.
The native smoke verifies successful world allocation from the free list, class id and default data fields, scale defaults, bucket 13 membership, delete cleanup, and type-list cleanup.
